## Sanitization checklist

> This repo is **public**. Everything merged here is world-readable, forever.
> Tick every box. If one doesn't apply, tick it and note why.

- [ ] No **client or prospect names** (or logos, domains, or identifying details)
- [ ] No **pricing, margins, retainers, deal sizes, or GMV figures**
- [ ] No **staff names** or internal team references
- [ ] No **real call transcripts, prospect lists, or PII** — examples are generic/fabricated
- [ ] No **internal repo paths** or references into the private workspace's client, prospect, or team folders
- [ ] No **secrets / API keys** — config reads from env vars only
- [ ] `python utils/leak_scan.py` passes locally
